title: new_with_store for testability is correct design
description: The new_with_store(Arc<dyn ObjectStore>, prefix) constructor allows unit tests to inject InMemory without running an S3 server. This is correct: the S3 store logic (CID computation, path building, error mapping) can be tested independently of the AWS SDK. A future contributor might suggest removing this in favor of mocking with wiremock; don't — wiremock-based S3 mocking is fragile (needs to handle AWS SigV4 auth) while InMemory tests the real trait implementation cleanly.
